## Error tracking

Added `app/global-error.tsx` as the Next.js App Router global error boundary. It captures otherwise uncaught root-level rendering exceptions through `posthog.captureException(error)` using the existing browser SDK initialization, and provides a retry UI with the required global `<html>` and `<body>` markup. No dependencies were added and no build, lint, or test commands were run in this instrumentation-only step.

Its sole property, `service`, comes from the trusted page-configured subject; no name, email, message, hashed email, or other user-entered data is sent to PostHog. This supplies the primary lead-conversion funnel event. Edited `app/publications/PublicationsClient.tsx` to capture `publications_more_loaded` only after the user’s Load more request succeeds, with the non-PII `items_loaded` count for content-engagement analysis. The existing `app/global-error.tsx` exception capture was untouched for the dedicated error-tracking task. No server-side event was added: the client contact conversion fires only after the contact API confirms success, and no `posthog-node` dependency or server initialization exists.
